rows.method: Four trainable alternating even/odd additive invertible couplings after frozen DURA

notes: Four additive temporal coupling layers have explicit analytic inverse without input, source clean, F or hidden context; floating point recovery verified on source.
Theoretical invertibility does not imply improved identity recognition or preserve information exactly under finite precision.
